title.en: Migrate a basic cluster to pro

descriptions.zh: ACK托管集群基础版迁移至ACK托管集群Pro版后，将新增[集群管理费用](~~462278~~)（由ACK收取），其他云资源计费保持不变。
descriptions.en: After you migrate an ACK managed Basic cluster to an ACK managed Pro cluster, a [cluster management fee](~~462278~~) charged by ACK is added. Billing for other cloud resources remains unchanged.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs migrate-cluster --cluster-id c21e0591548ba4c10bdb535d6572b0000 --oss-bucket-name bucket-0000 --oss-bucket-endpoint 0000000.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
